members.name: routing_v5
members.instructions: A customer of a digital bank wrote this message to support chat. Which kind of request is it? Pick the closest option.

criteria.unrecognised_card_payment: A card payment or purchase the customer did not make or does not recognise (even if they ask for a refund)
criteria.unrecognised_cash_withdrawal: A cash/ATM withdrawal on the account the customer did not make or does not recognise
criteria.unrecognised_direct_debit: A direct debit the customer did not set up or does not recognise, including wanting a direct debit refunded
criteria.compromised_card: Card or account compromised, someone else used it, suspected fraud or hacking
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost or stolen, reporting it, what to do (not a found card)
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgotten or not working app passcode or login, can't get into the app with passcode, new passcode
criteria.pin_blocked_or_change: PIN blocked, PIN not working, changing / resetting / forgotten PIN, where to change PIN
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for a purchase they made, changed mind, item not received, wants to cancel a purchase
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund that has not arrived or is not showing on the statement
criteria.charged_twice: Duplicate charge, charged twice or multiple times for one purchase
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra charge or small amount (e.g. an extra 1 pound, paying a pound more than the price) showing on the statement or in the app
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: ATM gave less, more or the wrong amount of cash, or cash not received from ATM
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment that the app or merchant cancelled or reverted, or that came back to the account (not the customer asking to cancel)
criteria.dispute_payment: Wants to dispute a payment (that they made)
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet, card delivery tracking
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery on a date, delivery abroad
criteria.card_linking: Adding / linking a card to the app, making a card show up in the app, reactivating a found lost card
criteria.card_not_working: Card stopped working, card is frozen, physical card not working, contactless not working
criteria.declined_card_payment: Card payment declined or rejected at a shop or online
criteria.pending_card_payment: Card payment still pending, not gone through yet
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM withdrawal declined, ATM didn't let me get cash
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: Cash withdrawal still pending or not showing
criteria.card_swallowed: ATM took / swallowed / kept my card
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card expiring, replacing an expiring card
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical card, a new card, a replacement card, additional/spare cards, card for family
criteria.virtual_card: Getting or using a virtual card or disposable virtual card, its limits, virtual card not working
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card the bank issues me will be a Visa or a Mastercard, asking to get one instead of the other
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted, which ATMs can be used, card limits
criteria.get_first_pin: Where to find the PIN for a new card
criteria.apple_google_pay: Apple Pay or Google Pay, including topping up through Apple Pay / Google Pay
criteria.pending_transfer: Bank transfer pending, how long transfers take
criteria.transfer_not_received: Transfer sent but not received by the recipient
criteria.cancel_transfer: Customer wants to cancel or revert a transfer or transaction they made, or fix one sent to the wrong account
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer or deposit money into the account, receiving money or my salary (including getting it paid in a given currency), incoming transfer missing
criteria.balance_not_updated: Balance not updated after a bank transfer, cheque or cash deposit
criteria.top_up_problem: Top-up failed, pending, reverted, money from top-up missing
criteria.top_up_how: How to top up: by card, bank transfer, cash, cheque; top-up limits; automatic top-up
criteria.card_payment_fee: A fee or extra amount charged on a purchase or card payment the customer made, including purchases from another country or from a store, and questions about card payment fees
criteria.cash_withdrawal_fee: Fee charged for ATM / cash withdrawal
criteria.transfer_fee: Fee charged for a transfer, or for receiving money
criteria.top_up_fee: Fee for topping up by card or bank transfer, international card
criteria.exchange_rate: Exchange rates, how they are set, wrong exchange rate on a payment or cash withdrawal
criteria.exchange_in_app: How to exchange currencies in the app, getting foreign currency
criteria.supported_currencies_cards: Which currencies are supported, which kinds of cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, credit cards) the bank accepts or I can use, e.g. to add money
criteria.verify_identity: Identity verification: documents needed, why it's needed, it's not working, the app can't recognise me
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or top-up card, top-up verification codes
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service is offered in
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: A transfer that was not allowed or is not possible, e.g. to a beneficiary (rather than declined or failed)
